select IFNULL(SUM(og.order_goods_commission),0) as sellOnCommission FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on ob.order_id = og.order_id where ob.shop_id = #{shopId} and og.drop_shipping = 1 and ob.original_order is null and ob.payment_code != 3 and ob.pay_code != 13 and ob.order_is_settlement ='0' AND ((ob.order_status IN ( '5', '6', '9', '13' ) AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 ) OR (ob.order_status = '9' AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 AND ob.order_refund_status = 2 ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 0 AND ob.order_status IN ( '6' ) ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 2 AND ob.order_status IN ( '9','12' ) ) ) AND og.order_id = #{orderId}

select sum(order_commission_fee) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where original_order = #{orderId}
